name: jev-model-router
description: Routes every Claude Code request with TypeSafe's Jev decision model (direct API or Vercel AI Gateway): the subagent model at agent.spawn, the main model once at session start so the prompt cache survives, and the reasoning effort of every main-loop turn. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier without a key. Fail-open everywhere.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's direct API (api.typesafe.ai). Preferred: it reports a calibrated confidence per answer.

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the Vercel AI Gateway (ai-gateway.vercel.sh). Used when no TypeSafe key is set.

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: auto picks TypeSafe when its key is set, else the Gateway, else the engine's built-in classifier. Force one with typesafe / gateway / builtin.

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Alias or full id for mechanical, local tasks

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Alias or full id for ordinary engineering work

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Alias or full id for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be before the router raises the model or the effort. Being wrong costs money, so the bar is low.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be before the router lowers the model or the effort. Being wrong starves a task, so the bar is high.

riskThreshold.title: Risk override
riskThreshold.description: P(risky) above which the deep tier and at least high effort are taken regardless of the confidence bars.

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick each subagent's model at agent.spawn. Subagents start with a fresh context, so this never breaks a cache.

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of every main-conversation turn.

mainModelRouting.title: Main model routing
mainModelRouting.description: session-start: pick the main model from the first prompt only, before any prompt cache exists (default). every-turn: re-route on every turn (invalidates the prompt cache). off: never touch the main model.

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before letting the request through unchanged.

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each classification and routing decision to the transcript and keep a status line under the prompt.
